svg.title: Four Checks Before an Irrevocable Bid
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-pre-bid-statutory-risk-tree; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Checks Before an Irrevocable Bid; subtitle: Proceed only when every branch has documented supporting evidence; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Read the four nodes sequentially: a documented pass moves to the next node; an unresolved issue stops the bid. Federal sale rules do not automatically govern municipal sales. California citations illustrate state-specific requirements and must be replaced or supplemented for the actual operating jurisdiction.; caption: Auction access, title evidence, restricted-property rules, and removal economics are separate checks; clearing one does not resolve the others.; stages: label: Seller authority and eligibility; value: Pass: eligible; stop: unresolved terms; numeric value: 1.0; detail: For federal lots, review 40 U.S.C. 545, 41 CFR Part 102-38, and the specific sale terms. For municipal lots, verify the seller's authority and local conditions. Record bidder eligibility, deposit requirements, payment deadlines, and authorized purchasing identity.; label: Ownership and title pathway; value: Pass: transferable; stop: document mismatch; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Match VIN or serial number to the sale record. For federal vehicles, establish whether SF-97 or another title document will be delivered and whether the state accepts that pathway. Review applicable dealer licensing and transfer duties, including California Vehicle Code sections 11700 and 5900 when operating there.; label: Restricted property and DEMIL; value: Pass: permitted; stop: unresolved restriction; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Review the listing's demilitarization instructions, end-use terms, and controlled-property conditions. Exclude lots whose obligations exceed documented capability or authorization. Evaluate export restrictions separately under 15 CFR 736.2 and 22 CFR 121.1 where applicable; an SF-97 does not waive those restrictions.; label: Permits, removal, and cash capacity; value: Pass: funded plan; stop: uncovered obligation; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Confirm applicable seller permits, resale-certificate treatment, and tax collection obligations; California Revenue and Taxation Code section 6071 is one state example. Require carrier availability, site access, insurance, repair limits, and sufficient cash through the contractual removal deadline.

text.title: Four Checks Before an Irrevocable Bid
text.tspan: Four Checks Before an Irrevocable Bid

circle.title: label: Seller authority and eligibility; value: Pass: eligible; stop: unresolved terms; numeric value: 1.0; detail: For federal lots, review 40 U.S.C. 545, 41 CFR Part 102-38, and the specific sale terms. For municipal lots, verify the seller's authority and local conditions. Record bidder eligibility, deposit requirements, payment deadlines, and authorized purchasing identity.

text.title: For federal lots, review 40 U.S.C. 545, 41 CFR Part 102-38, and the specific sale terms. For municipal lots, verify the seller's authority and local conditions. Record bidder eligibility, deposit requirements, payment deadlines, and authorized purchasing identity.

circle.title: label: Ownership and title pathway; value: Pass: transferable; stop: document mismatch; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Match VIN or serial number to the sale record. For federal vehicles, establish whether SF-97 or another title document will be delivered and whether the state accepts that pathway. Review applicable dealer licensing and transfer duties, including California Vehicle Code sections 11700 and 5900 when operating there.

text.title: Match VIN or serial number to the sale record. For federal vehicles, establish whether SF-97 or another title document will be delivered and whether the state accepts that pathway. Review applicable dealer licensing and transfer duties, including California Vehicle Code sections 11700 and 5900 when operating there.

circle.title: label: Restricted property and DEMIL; value: Pass: permitted; stop: unresolved restriction; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Review the listing's demilitarization instructions, end-use terms, and controlled-property conditions. Exclude lots whose obligations exceed documented capability or authorization. Evaluate export restrictions separately under 15 CFR 736.2 and 22 CFR 121.1 where applicable; an SF-97 does not waive those restrictions.

text.title: Review the listing's demilitarization instructions, end-use terms, and controlled-property conditions. Exclude lots whose obligations exceed documented capability or authorization. Evaluate export restrictions separately under 15 CFR 736.2 and 22 CFR 121.1 where applicable; an SF-97 does not waive those restrictions.

circle.title: label: Permits, removal, and cash capacity; value: Pass: funded plan; stop: uncovered obligation; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Confirm applicable seller permits, resale-certificate treatment, and tax collection obligations; California Revenue and Taxation Code section 6071 is one state example. Require carrier availability, site access, insurance, repair limits, and sufficient cash through the contractual removal deadline.

text.title: Confirm applicable seller permits, resale-certificate treatment, and tax collection obligations; California Revenue and Taxation Code section 6071 is one state example. Require carrier availability, site access, insurance, repair limits, and sufficient cash through the contractual removal deadline.

Assumptions: Read the four nodes sequentially: a documented pass moves to the next node; an unresolved issue stops the bid. Federal sale rules do not automatically govern municipal sales. California citations illustrate state-specific requirements and must be replaced or supplemented for the actual operating jurisdiction.
